summary:
Adds coupon codes to checkout. `findCoupon` looks a code up and drops expired ones, `discountFor` turns it into cents, and `cartTotals` subtracts the discount before tax is added. The money helpers move to `src/lib` and the deprecated `legacy/priceUtils` goes away.

```
checkoutSummary(request)
└─ findCoupon(couponCode)      new, src/coupons.ts
└─ cartTotals(items, coupon)
   └─ discountFor(coupon, subtotal)
   └─ tax = subtotal * TAX_RATE  (rounding removed)
```
evidence: `tests/coupons.test.ts` checks that active coupons are found, expired and unknown codes are ignored, and that a percent coupon takes the right share. `tests/cart.test.ts` checks a 10% coupon on a $25 cart, but its expected total (2450) taxes the full subtotal, so it locks in the tax bug below. No test covers a fixed coupon larger than the cart, lowercase codes, or fractional tax.

danger.note: Wrong totals reach customers until reverted: negative totals with large fixed coupons and fractional-cent tax.

spec.note: The description says codes are case-insensitive and tax is charged on the discounted price. The code compares codes exactly and taxes the full subtotal. The `date-fns` dependency is added but not used, and the description does not mention it.

comments.body:
A fixed coupon bigger than the cart makes the total negative: `WELCOME5` on a $3 item gives -$2.00 plus tax. Cap the discount at the subtotal.

```suggestion
  return Math.min(coupon.amount, subtotal);
```

comments.body:
The description says tax is charged on the discounted price, but this taxes the full subtotal. It also drops the rounding that `roundPrice` did, so `tax` can be fractional cents (1999 * 0.08 = 159.92).

```suggestion
  const tax = Math.round((subtotal - discount) * TAX_RATE);
```

comments.body:
Codes should be case-insensitive, but the raw input goes to `findCoupon`, which compares exactly. `spring10` or ` SPRING10` finds nothing and the discount is silently skipped.

```suggestion
  const coupon = request.couponCode ? findCoupon(request.couponCode.trim().toUpperCase()) : undefined;
```
This expectation taxes the pre-discount subtotal (2500 - 250 + 200). With tax on the discounted price it is 2430, so the test will fail once the tax bug is fixed. Update it together with `cart.ts`.
